blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Explains the causes and dynamics behind earthquakes and volcanic activity.
Controls and drives the movement of plate tectonics.
Serves as a primary source for essential minerals and geothermal energy.
Maintains the magnetic field that protects the Earth.
Questions frequently test how Earth's interior processes generate the protective magnetic field.
Remember that geothermal energy and key mineral sources originate directly from interior processes.
Plate tectonics and major seismic hazards (earthquakes/volcanoes) are governed by the Earth's interior.

blocks.content: • Source of minerals and geothermal energy.
